entry.title: MPC Remote 1.2.0
entry.summary: **New in 1.2.0:** a Gen2 (aarch64) zip too, for the MPC Sample and Gen2 devices; on the Sample, its own button table (found by its "MPC Sample" MIDI client), so the browser's buttons press the Sample's keys. The MPC screen in a browser, and an MCP server so an AI model can see and touch it, play MIDI and read files. ## Requirements - A Gen2 MPC OS standalone device (aarch64: Live III, One G2, Key(s) G2). The installer refuses anything else. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC

entry.title: MPC Remote 1.0.3
entry.summary: Button injection fallback: when the ALSA sequencer's "Virtual RawMIDI" port isn't available, buttons now fall back to writing raw MIDI bytes to /dev/midi_inject or /data/midi.in. The existing sequencer path is unchanged for devices that have it.

entry.title: MPC Remote 1.0.2
entry.summary: ## What's new in 1.0.2 - **Press the device's hardware buttons** (#3). PLAY, STOP, REC, UNDO, MIXER, the arrows and the rest can now be pressed from the web page (a new button row), the HTTP API (`GET /buttons`, `GET /button?name=`) and MCP (`list_buttons`, `press_button`, `learn_button`). The addin sends MPC the same MIDI note its control surface would, from a port nothing can subscribe to, so a button press never reaches a track as a note. - **Akai Force:** 22 buttons are built in and found au

entry.title: MPC Remote 1.0.1
entry.summary: ## What's new in 1.0.1 - **Works on MockbaMod without manual steps.** MockbaMod starts MPC with its own preload list, so the addin used to install fine but never load. The installer now spots a MockbaMod card, adds an `AddOns/run_remote.sh` hook that puts the addin on that list at every boot, and adds it right away.
